about.title: About Me
about.bio1: I am a Full Stack Developer specialising in web and mobile applications, with over 2 years of part-time experience. My focus is on building secure, scalable, and sustainable applications that serve clients worldwide.
about.bio2: I hold a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science Engineering. I enjoy problem-solving, debugging, and participating in coding competitions to sharpen my skills, and I'm constantly exploring new technologies to stay ahead in this fast-evolving industry.

projects.title: E-Commerce Website
projects.main: A full-fledged MERN stack e-commerce platform with product browsing, cart, secure payments, user authentication, and admin inventory control.
projects.fullDescription: A complete, production-ready full stack e-commerce web application architected with MongoDB, Express.js, React, and Node.js. Features seamless user authentication with JWT, rich product catalog browsing with real-time filtering, shopping cart persistence, secure payment integration via Stripe/Razorpay, customer order history tracking, and a comprehensive admin management dashboard for handling products, stock inventory, and customer transactions.

projects.title: Shopping App
projects.main: Scan product barcodes to auto-add items to cart with live pricing and secure payment gateway checkout.
projects.fullDescription: Cross-platform Flutter mobile application designed for next-generation retail shopping. Shoppers can scan barcode tags directly with camera vision to instantly populate their digital shopping cart with real-time price calculations and discounts. Integrated with Razorpay/Stripe checkout SDK for frictionless in-app payments, order invoice generation, and real-time synchronization with cloud inventory.

projects.title: Smart EVM Machine
projects.main: IoT-powered Electronic Voting Machine with RFID authentication, real-time vote counting, and Firebase backend.
projects.fullDescription: An embedded IoT voting system built using the ESP32 microcontroller, RC522 RFID reader module, OLED display, and Google Firebase Realtime Database. Ensures transparent and tamper-resistant election processes by validating voter identity with encrypted RFID cards, preventing duplicate vote submissions, and streaming live cryptographic vote tallies directly to an administrative web console.

projects.title: Number Plate Detection
projects.main: Real-time vehicle number plate detection using OpenCV and YOLO with AI-driven OCR recognition.
projects.fullDescription: Computer vision pipeline leveraging YOLO deep learning object detection algorithms and OpenCV image processing. Detects vehicle license plates in real-time camera video streams, isolates plate regions of interest, corrects perspective skews, and performs Optical Character Recognition (OCR) via Tesseract to automate parking toll entries, gate security, and vehicle tracking systems.

projects.title: Blog Website
projects.main: Dynamic blog platform with full CRUD, rich text editing, image uploads, and fully responsive layout.
projects.fullDescription: Modern full-stack blogging platform built with Next.js App Router, Tailwind CSS, and MongoDB Atlas. Features an intuitive markdown/rich-text editor, cloud media asset management, category taxonomy, dynamic SEO metadata generation, server-side caching for instant article delivery, and interactive reader discussion comments.

projects.title: Text to Image Generator
projects.main: AI-powered web app converting text prompts into images via ClipDrop API with style options and downloads.
projects.fullDescription: Interactive generative AI application utilizing ClipDrop / Stability AI diffusion APIs. Users can write descriptive prompts, select visual styles (photorealistic, anime, cinematic, 3D render), generate high-resolution art assets in seconds, view prompt revision history, and download generated creations directly to local storage.

projects.title: Waste Picker Robot
projects.main: Autonomous robot for public waste collection using ESP32-CAM, Arduino, ultrasonic sensors, and mechanical arm.
projects.fullDescription: An autonomous robotics project designed to clean public walkways and campus environments. Equipped with an ESP32-CAM module for vision transmission, HC-SR04 ultrasonic distance sensors for dynamic obstacle avoidance, an Arduino microcontroller controlling motor drivers, and a servo-powered multi-axis mechanical arm capable of grasping litter and depositing it into an onboard bin.

projects.title: Travelon - Tourist Safety System
projects.main: Smart tourist safety platform with real-time live tracking, geofencing alerts, and SOS emergency response system.
projects.fullDescription: A comprehensive tourist protection ecosystem developed across Next.js, Flutter, and Node.js WebSocket infrastructure. Mobile companions provide tourists with real-time GPS telemetry, safe zone boundaries, and single-tap SOS distress broadcasts. The central monitoring web dashboard allows tourism police and certified tour operators to view live tourist clusters on interactive maps, trigger perimeter alerts, and coordinate rapid emergency dispatch.
